subject.title: feat(runtime): show OpenClaw sessions in Live Activity

question: Should Command Center Live Activity be a core runtime feature, or should it be implemented as a Command Center plugin/owner integration using existing event and message hook seams?
rationale: Repository policy and VISION favor plugins for optional integrations, but Command Center may be an official companion surface; automation cannot decide that product boundary or privacy contract.

options.title: Move to plugin/owner integration
options.body: Keep this out of core and publish or host a Command Center plugin that subscribes to agent events and message hooks, adding a core API only if a specific missing seam is proven.

options.title: Sponsor core with privacy contract
options.body: Allow a core emitter only after maintainers document the env surface, metadata egress, security boundary, probe filtering, and live Command Center proof requirements.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: If Command Center ownership is outside this repo, close this PR and ask for a narrow package or owner-repo implementation instead of carrying core runtime churn.

recommendation.title: Move to plugin/owner integration
recommendation.body: Keep this out of core and publish or host a Command Center plugin that subscribes to agent events and message hooks, adding a core API only if a specific missing seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the touched current runtime surfaces and recent plugin/internal boundary refactors.
